note: Detections are model boxes at or above 0.25 after NMS. Folder names are the existing filing. box_on_defensible_defect is a visual check of the drawn boxes, not a new label. null means that annotated image was not opened box by box.

images.review: Filed as corrosion. Drawn boxes are scratch and dent on seams, handles, and shadows. No corrosion box at or above 0.25. I would not defend those boxes as scratches or dents.
The cabinet is visibly rusty. The only box is corrosion 0.479 on the top rim, not on the rusted face.
Broken hardware is visible at the lower left. The drawn boxes are scratches on the upper-right interior, not on that damage, and not missing_or_loose_component.
Corrosion and dent boxes sit on ordinary switch handles and panel hardware.
